name: Western bean cutworm
description_damage: See: Common Pests of Vegetable Crops
monitoring: Apply any of the recommended pesticides as allowed per label 10 to 20 days after the peak moth flight.

management.cultural: Weed control is important. Lambsquarters and wild mustard attract egg-laying females and provide a source of food for larvae. Fall tillage can help destroy overwintering pupae. Home gardeners: Control weeds, grasses, and debris in the vegetable garden that provide cover; hand-pick cutworm larvae, using a flashlight to find them as they are nocturnal, if practical. Scratch the soil at the base of plants to find larvae in the daytime.
